survival_horizons.method: From observation time T, use future trades/snapshots/postgard or red_pump TIMEOUT censoring at 24h for survival analysis.

plus_x_before_minus_y_barriers.method: Walk forward price_sol / postgrad price_usd path after T; detect first barrier hits.
caveats: requires clean price path; drop null/inconsistent trade prices

future_return_distributions.method: Compute returns at fixed horizons from T using price path.

mfe_mae.method: Max favorable/adverse excursion from price path after T within horizon.

time_to_graduation_crash_inactivity.method: graduation via graduated_at/migrations; crash via drawdown barriers; inactivity via time since last trade/unique wallet activity.

buyer_activity_persistence.method: Recompute per-wallet trade counts/volumes over windows from trades; optionally join RED-COHORT membership as coordination feature.
caveats: ignore wallet_stats aggregates; exclude system program

source_specific_labels_to_ignore_as_cano: quickstart rug filter on outcome_label='rug' (does not exist)
